summary_en: Art Vivant will cancel all treasury shares held as of November 12, 2026, subject to approval of a share consolidation scheduled to take effect on November 13, 2026. As of September 2, 2026, 631 treasury shares were held out of 9,152,316 total issued shares including treasury shares.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Art Vivant announced on September 17, 2026 that its board of directors has approved the cancellation of all treasury shares held by the company as of November 12, 2026. As of September 2, 2026, the company held 631 treasury shares out of 9,152,316 total issued shares including treasury stock, representing approximately 0.01% of issued shares. The cancellation is conditional upon shareholder approval of a share consolidation scheduled to take effect on November 13, 2026, which will also involve the elimination of the minimum trading unit requirement and certain amendments to the company's articles of incorporation. The cancellation is being executed in accordance with Article 178 of the Companies Act.
